verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a public Create Campaign API endpoint that creates a campaign from parameters and returns it, authenticated with scoped private keys or OAuth. It also states that Klaviyo is accessible headlessly through its public APIs and MCP server, so campaigns can be created without the dashboard. However, the pack contains no documentation of an endpoint to schedule or send a campaign, so only the creation half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint for scheduling/sending a campaign, details of campaign create parameters (audiences, content/template assignment), independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end API-only campaign send.
